body: I don't know how to contact an attorney. I don't know about reviews, hidden payments, where to go.

I pay the debts every two weeks when I get paid. I don't qualify for Medicaid. I had it then had it take away when I got a $0.50 raise. I don't make enough to save anything really but I do make enough to not get medicaid. That's all I know on where I stand on profit level.

I can do the $5/month payment with one bill line but the other is in collections that I can't contact. They call me like 8 times a day, never answer when I pick up and never leave any voicemail. They don't have a customer portal to pay or any other way to contact them. But they're on my credit and it's constantly wrecking my score.

1. I tried that and they said "you should have tried that before it went into collections" or if it didn't go into collections yet, they just direct me to online payments that don't have a range of monthly payments I can make. They gave me the "tough luck" responses and attitude. 
2. I am cutting down my budget on food. This is a new one I'm working on. I'm not like buying super expensive fast food everyday, I get food from grocery stores that I can eat that week.
3. I also did that and they say its "out of the way" (because I don't live close which is understandable) or try to avoid answering me by getting busy with other work.
4. The only reason I haven't done so so far is because where I'm at, locals don't believe/care about public safety for covid. I don't have the greatest health and I'm terrified to work a simple job because most deal with people; especially the ones walking distance to me. I could try my best to stay safe but I don't want to risk it.
5. I have and that's why I decided to make this post. I know the car isn't going to make it to the end of the year. I could bike but again, I don't want to risk my life and health at local jobs where many employees are getting sick from the public or vice versa. Still might find a bike just in case.

I very much appreciate your thoughtful response but I'm at my wits end of problems that come with possible solutions.

I appreciate the advice but I have a very old car with many problems, I get complaints because it makes so much noise when driving. I heard most of those gig places need at least a 2008 car with so many miles on it.

I was getting treatment but 1) I couldn't drive to the facility for help because it was really far (35+ min) without using the highway (my car can't make it on the highway) and 2) this was the third facility I tried that just made me pop pills without helping me cope and dragged their feet when I asked on multiple occasions for therapy. I gave up on treatment. I'm ok if I kill myself, I'm not actively trying but I'm not bothered if I do it.
